name: h3_timeline_card
description: THE video interface — multi-window film with SLA sparse attention, joint video+audio per window, auto-stitched into one mp4. The calls document IS the timeline.

model.description: The boarded family to run — the request's top-level `model`. Options: h3-timeline, h3, h3-keyframe.

prompt.description: Verb-first motion + the sounds. For keyframes the image already sets the scene — prompt what CHANGES.

image.description: Absolute path to the PNG the video must start on (h3-keyframe). Optional for h3/h3-timeline.

seed.description: Same seed across re-rolls = same world texture

steps.description: 12 for draft; 30 standard; 10 with the turbo LoRA

sharpen_enabled.description: Apply AMD FidelityFX RCAS sharpening to the final output. Strength 0.3 looks natural.

sharpen_strength.description: RCAS sharpening intensity. 0.3 = natural; 0.5 = crisp; 0.0 = off.

interpolate_enabled.description: Apply FILM (Feature-aware Interpolation for Large Motion) frame interpolation to double the frame rate. Doubles render time.

shift_video.description: Timestep shift for video attention. Higher = more coherent motion.

shift_audio.description: Timestep shift for audio attention. Lower = more detailed sound.
